summary.text: Sonja Mentzer is a Democratic candidate for South Dakota House of Representatives District 11, a two-seat district, in the November 3, 2026 general election; incumbent Republicans Brian Mulder and Keri Weems and Libertarian Tracey Quint are also on the ballot.
She is a director of operations at a non-emergency transportation company and ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Sonja Mentzer was born in Aberdeen, South Dakota, graduated from Chamberlain High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from South Dakota State University in 2001.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in Chamberlain, spent six years as the general manager of a fast food restaurant after college, and is now the director of operations for a non-emergency transportation company.
She said she is the mother of an active duty U.S. Marine and a high school senior.
Mentzer was a Democratic candidate for South Dakota House District 11 in 2024 and lost the general election to incumbents Brian Mulder and Keri Weems.
In her 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said her key campaign messages are making health care more accessible and affordable and opposing what she described as attacks on public schools.
She named economic development, health care and education as her policy interests.
